hook: Upside down over the capital in an F-22.
narration: Upside down over Washington, D.C., in an F-22 Raptor.
This is the Air Force F-22 demo team pilot, practicing over the National Mall.
It was July third, 2026, for the nation's two hundred fiftieth birthday.
The Raptor's engine nozzles swivel up and down, so it can turn and point in ways most jets cannot.
Every roll swung the whole city across the canopy.
outcome: He flew the routine right past the Washington Monument.
title: Upside down over D.C. in an F-22
description:
U.S. Air Force Capt. Nick Le Tourneau, F-22 Raptor Aerial Demonstration Team pilot and commander, practices his demonstration over the National Mall during Fourth of July celebrations for the nation's 250th anniversary in Washington, D.C., July 3, 2026.
